newsitem.title: HONG KONG: U.S. envoy in Hong Kong says light hand needed.
newsitem.headline: U.S. envoy in Hong Kong says light hand needed.

text.p: The chief United States representative in Hong Kong said on Monday China should rule the colony with a light hand to ensure its continued prosperity.
Consul-General Richard Boucher said the United States had important trade and other ties to Hong Kong which it wanted to continue when the British territory returns to Beijing on July 1.

"Whether they will in fact continue and grow depends on to what extent Hong Kong goes on being Hong Kong," Boucher said in a speech to a conference organised by the Far Eastern Economic Review magazine.
Boucher said Hong Kong's business strength rested on the rule of law, the free flow of information and clean efficient government.

"Our view is simple: the framework for Hong Kong's reversion to China is a good one. We expect to see it implemented. Any compromise in one portion of these commitments can harm Hong Kong's prospects," he said.
Boucher picked out press freedom, an elected legislature and and freedom of expression as areas the United States intended to watch closely in Hong Kong's development.

"We will be watching developments in these areas closely as the transition continues, and using our influence where we can since their outcome will affect Hong Kong's prospects for all of us," he said.
